findings.description: Target descriptive Claim and inherited Authority/D34 valid8/admissible5 tuple/precondition precedence unreviewed; no sibling identity.
Explicit/challengeable/assertion-of-may-perform and named scope/owner/operation/object/basis/effect candidate meanings need exact owner/route and permission denotation.
Field markers/nonEMPTY values and one selected token per field are not exact source tuple equality, global singleton cardinality or field denotation.
Descriptive right and necessary completeness do not suffice for actual qualification, admissibility, validity, authentication or governing effect.
Known implicit markers constrain selected post-classification state, not missing/unknown equivalence, exact candidate/residue exclusivity, becomes history or universal transition proof.
Scope/context/effectivity/transfer/revocation/succession need reviewed operational/deontic and temporal mappings; hypothetical profiles not actual execution.
Current exact Claim carrier has missing source tuple fields, owner/basis/scope joins and metadata/TR alignment gaps; canonical schema changes not performed.
Twenty-five authored uses and shared D34 local bytes lack complete edge/common-carrier/meaning alignment and authenticated live source/owner fidelity.
